basis: Themes and bilingual one-sentence notes assigned individually from reviewed abstracts, explicit excerpts or authorized online short-comment review; not an automated classifier or quality rating.

categories.label: 社区发现与网络推断、重构

10.1038/s41467-026-75453-3.note_en: Roman road-network organization and intermediary positions, with associations to modern roads rather than a causal claim.
10.1038/s41467-026-75453-3.note_zh: 从网络组织和中介位置分析罗马道路，并考察其与现代道路的关联。

10.1038/s42256-026-01306-9.note_en: Task demands and capacity constraints shape modularity in recurrent networks, with a comparison to brain organization.
10.1038/s42256-026-01306-9.note_zh: 任务需求和容量约束如何塑造循环网络的模块结构？文章也与脑网络组织作了比较。

10.1103/g875-ldn5.note_en: Thermodynamic bounds on steady states and reaction affinities constrain candidate network topologies and hidden pathways.
10.1103/g875-ldn5.note_zh: 稳态与反应亲和力的热力学界，为检验反应网络拓扑和隐藏路径提供约束。

10.1103/6m2z-wlmb.note_en: Plasma wave packets mapped to network percolation give a global-instability threshold; experimental validation remains pending.
10.1103/6m2z-wlmb.note_zh: 将等离子体局域波包映射为网络渗流，刻画全局失稳阈值；尚待实验验证。

10.1126/science.aec3917.note_en: How do nonequilibrium dynamics and changing connectivity affect associative-memory capacity and recall in spin networks?
10.1126/science.aec3917.note_zh: 非平衡动力学与动态连接，如何影响自旋网络的联想记忆容量和回忆？

10.1126/sciadv.aef2894.note_en: A self-organizing network model explores trade-offs among communication efficiency, computational reliability and hub resilience.
10.1126/sciadv.aef2894.note_zh: 自组织网络模型考察通信效率、计算可靠性和枢纽抗攻击能力之间的拓扑权衡。

10.1073/pnas.2614238123.note_en: Dynamical mean-field theory links degree distributions to starvation transitions and molecular-abundance scaling.
10.1073/pnas.2614238123.note_zh: 动力学平均场理论将度分布与代谢饥饿转变、分子丰度的标度规律联系起来。

10.1073/pnas.2537815123.note_en: Network topology identifies independently controllable modules, tested in a cell-cycle reaction network.
10.1073/pnas.2537815123.note_zh: 网络拓扑如何产生可独立控制的模块？细胞周期反应网络提供了一个检验。

10.1126/sciadv.aeh8819.note_en: Designing reaction-network topologies and parameters to produce a desired dynamical function.
10.1126/sciadv.aeh8819.note_zh: 从想要的动力学功能出发，反向设计反应网络的拓扑与参数。

10.1126/science.aeg3946.note_en: A theory of how node and link heterogeneity can enhance stability in networks with non-Hermitian dynamics.
10.1126/science.aeg3946.note_zh: 节点与连接的异质性，在非厄米动力学条件下如何增强网络稳定性？

10.1073/pnas.2604777123.note_en: Finding provably minimal temporary interventions in logical networks while preserving natural regulatory dynamics.
10.1073/pnas.2604777123.note_zh: 在保留自然调控动力学的条件下，寻找逻辑网络中可证明的最小暂时干预。

10.1038/s41467-026-77357-8.note_en: Contact-network percolation offers a way to understand collective tumor-cell motion and mechano-chemical feedback.
10.1038/s41467-026-77357-8.note_zh: 细胞接触网络的渗流，为理解肿瘤细胞的群体运动和机械化学反馈提供了一个切入点。

10.1103/9y9m-q7qj.note_en: How does allowing local flexibility in preferential attachment change degree distributions and network hierarchy?
10.1103/9y9m-q7qj.note_zh: 优先连接允许局部灵活性后，网络的度分布与层级结构会怎样改变？

10.1073/pnas.2613908123.note_en: Neighbor communication and limited attention help explain echo chambers and failures of collective decision-making.
10.1073/pnas.2613908123.note_zh: 邻居间的通信与有限注意力，如何形成回音室并影响群体决策？

10.1073/pnas.2526156123.note_en: Coupled neuron–synapse dynamics connect persistent oscillatory memory to connectivity eigenvalues.
10.1073/pnas.2526156123.note_zh: 节点与突触的耦合动力学，将持续振荡记忆与连接矩阵的特征值联系起来。

10.1038/s41467-026-76416-4.note_en: Distinguishing link observation from link existence to infer missing host–virus connections in biased network data.
10.1038/s41467-026-76416-4.note_zh: 把链接的观测倾向与真实关系分开建模，用于推断偏采样宿主—病毒网络中的缺失链接。

10.1038/s41467-026-77340-3.note_en: Separating intrinsic model bias from interaction effects in the opinion dynamics of LLM agents.
10.1038/s41467-026-77340-3.note_zh: 大模型讨论中的意见变化，分别受到模型自身偏置和相互作用多大影响？

10.1103/61hq-rs8x.note_en: How do dimension and symmetry shape synchronization transitions on complete graphs and locally coupled lattices?
10.1103/61hq-rs8x.note_zh: 完全图与局部耦合晶格上的同步转变，如何受到维度和对称性的影响？

10.1126/science.aek9090.note_en: A Perspective on when noise and parameter heterogeneity can stabilize interacting groups, from oscillators to power grids.
10.1126/science.aek9090.note_zh: 这篇观点文章讨论噪声与参数异质性何时有助于集体稳定，涉及振子同步和电网。

10.1073/pnas.2622915123.note_en: A Commentary connecting biological transport and bus networks through resource-constrained optimization and adaptive flow.
10.1073/pnas.2622915123.note_zh: 从叶脉到公交，这篇评论以资源约束优化和导流自适应讨论运输网络的组织。

10.1038/s42005-026-02773-7.note_en: Adaptive interlayer coupling changes synchronization thresholds for signals on nodes and higher-dimensional simplices.
10.1038/s42005-026-02773-7.note_zh: 自适应层间耦合改变节点及高维单纯形信号的同步阈值。

10.1038/s42005-026-02822-1.note_en: A learned mean-field model incorporates sparse neuronal connectivity into whole-brain dynamics and parameter inference.
10.1038/s42005-026-02822-1.note_zh: 数据驱动平均场将稀疏神经连接纳入全脑动力学与参数推断。

10.1038/s42005-026-02839-6.note_en: Spatial clustering and heterogeneous trustworthiness balance local trust formation against its spread through interacting populations.
10.1038/s42005-026-02839-6.note_zh: 空间聚集与可信度异质性共同调节信任的局部形成及扩散。

10.1038/s42005-026-02852-9.note_en: A topological Dirac framework selects synchronization clusters jointly on nodes and hyperedges of directed hypergraphs.
10.1038/s42005-026-02852-9.note_zh: 拓扑 Dirac 框架在有向超图的节点与超边上设计簇同步状态。

10.1038/s42005-026-02860-9.note_en: An edge-centric analysis traces time-varying brain-network bottlenecks and recurring functional pathways during epileptic seizures.
10.1038/s42005-026-02860-9.note_zh: 边中心分析追踪癫痫发作过程中时变脑网络瓶颈及重复出现的功能传播路径。

10.1063/5.0331194.note_en: Pendula coupled through a planar platform exhibit geometry-dependent transitions between translational and rotational synchronization modes.
10.1063/5.0331194.note_zh: 经平面平台耦合的摆表现出由空间几何控制的平移与转动同步模式转换。

10.1063/5.0336997.note_en: Interaction range, delays and memristive feedback shape chimera states, synchronization and energy density in a neuronal ring.
10.1063/5.0336997.note_zh: 相互作用范围、时延及忆阻反馈共同塑造神经元环上的奇美拉态、同步及能量密度。

10.1063/5.0337453.note_en: Pairwise and group interactions alter cross-topic opinion coupling and the bifurcations leading to multidimensional polarization.
10.1063/5.0337453.note_zh: 成对及群体相互作用改变跨议题意见耦合和多维极化的分岔机制。

10.1063/5.0338836.note_en: Coupled asset-return maps generate statistical factors as synchronization modes whose dimensionality depends on coupling-matrix nullity.
10.1063/5.0338836.note_zh: 资产收益耦合映射将统计因子解释为同步模态，其维数取决于耦合矩阵零空间。

10.1063/5.0339751.note_en: Small excitability differences select reproducible sequential switching in a minimal three-unit network with symmetric coupling.
10.1063/5.0339751.note_zh: 微小兴奋性差异在对称耦合的三单元网络中选择可重复的顺序切换。

10.1063/5.0341330.note_en: Finite random neural networks display diverse routes to chaos and a size-dependent crossover in its onset.
10.1063/5.0341330.note_zh: 有限随机神经网络呈现多种通向混沌的路径及随系统规模变化的过渡区间。

10.1063/5.0342298.note_en: A branching-process and percolation framework relates adaptive vigilance and network clustering to epidemic invasion and final size.
10.1063/5.0342298.note_zh: 分枝过程与渗流框架联系行为警觉适应、网络聚类和疫情入侵及最终规模。

10.1063/5.0343851.note_en: Second-order memristive synapses support coupling-dependent synchronization and chimera-like states in a ring of spiking neurons.
10.1063/5.0343851.note_zh: 二阶忆阻突触在脉冲神经元环中产生随耦合变化的同步及类奇美拉态。

10.1063/5.0346196.note_en: Higher-order transmission creates subthreshold bistability and reshapes epidemic attraction basins within a degree-homogeneous mean-field approximation.
10.1063/5.0346196.note_zh: 在度均匀平均场近似下，高阶传播产生阈下双稳态并改变疫情吸引域。

10.1063/5.0346282.note_en: Second-order phase reduction captures bistable synchronization and three-cluster states missed by first-order descriptions of two-group oscillator networks.
10.1063/5.0346282.note_zh: 二阶相位约化捕捉两群振子网络中一阶描述遗漏的双稳同步及三簇状态。

10.1063/5.0347364.note_en: Multiplex metapopulation dynamics connect information-driven mobility and quarantine interventions to epidemic thresholds and prevalence.
10.1063/5.0347364.note_zh: 多层集合种群动力学联系信息驱动迁移、隔离干预与疫情阈值及流行规模。

10.1063/5.0348359.note_en: This scoping review separates nonlinear multiplayer payoffs from higher-order topology effects in evolutionary games on structured populations.
10.1063/5.0348359.note_zh: 该范围综述区分结构化种群演化博弈中的非线性多人收益效应与高阶拓扑效应。

10.1063/5.0349270.note_en: A spectral master-stability correspondence links continuous media to network synchronization, including reentrant stability and directed-network quasiperiodicity.
10.1063/5.0349270.note_zh: 谱主稳定对应关系联系连续介质与网络同步，包括重入稳定及有向网络准周期现象。

10.1063/5.0349486.note_en: Lattice percolation analysis relates reduced site coordination to barrier placement, connectivity thresholds and modeled intervention costs.
10.1063/5.0349486.note_zh: 格点渗流分析将节点配位数降低与屏障布置、连通阈值及模型干预成本联系起来。

10.1063/5.0349743.note_en: Two coupled bistable oscillators exhibit symmetry-breaking periodic states, phase locking and amplitude death across coupling and detuning regimes.
10.1063/5.0349743.note_zh: 两个耦合双稳振子在不同耦合与失谐区间呈现对称破缺周期态、锁相及振幅死亡。

10.1063/5.0349918.note_en: Nonlocal nonlinear evolution of pairwise dissimilarities drives a hierarchical hyperedge-merging procedure for hypergraph clustering.
10.1063/5.0349918.note_zh: 节点成对差异的非局域非线性演化驱动超图聚类中的层次超边合并。

10.1063/5.0350813.note_en: Coalescing random walks characterize weak-selection conditions for reporting strategies and institutional incentives in networked public goods games.
10.1063/5.0350813.note_zh: 合并随机游走刻画网络公共品博弈中举报策略及制度激励的弱选择条件。

10.1063/5.0351153.note_en: Dual reinforcement-learning values balance immediate payoffs and delayed neighborhood welfare to support cooperation in spatial public goods games.
10.1063/5.0351153.note_zh: 双重强化学习价值协调即时个人收益与延迟邻域福利，调节空间公共品博弈中的合作。

10.1063/5.0351165.note_en: Evolving social bonds and helping responses create feedback loops that sustain cooperation within nested interaction groups.
10.1063/5.0351165.note_zh: 演化中的社会纽带与帮助响应形成反馈，在嵌套互动群体中维持合作。

10.1063/5.0351619.note_en: Second-order Laplacian perturbation estimates guide driver-node selection for pinning control while reducing the modeled computational cost.
10.1063/5.0351619.note_zh: 二阶拉普拉斯扰动估计指导牵制控制的驱动节点选择，并降低模型中的计算开销。

10.1063/5.0351862.note_en: Degree heterogeneity and spatial connectivity change strategy-environment coevolution, with intermediate average degree favoring cooperation in the tested models.
10.1063/5.0351862.note_zh: 度异质性与空间连接改变策略—环境共同演化，测试模型中的中等平均度有利于合作。

10.1063/5.0355088.note_en: Cooperative spatial clusters and environmental feedback generate survival resonance near a modeled population-collapse boundary.
10.1063/5.0355088.note_zh: 合作空间团簇与环境反馈在模型的种群崩溃边界附近产生生存共振。

10.1103/16r5-nddc.note_en: Graph-dependent finite-time amplification predicts observable oscillations and helps select synchrony levels in p-bit annealing dynamics.
10.1103/16r5-nddc.note_zh: 依赖图结构的有限时间放大判据预测可观测振荡，并辅助选择概率比特退火的同步更新程度。

10.1103/23wf-kb12.note_en: Adaptive directed springs enable mechanical networks to learn input patterns, with stability depending on network architecture.
10.1103/23wf-kb12.note_zh: 自适应有向弹簧使机械网络学习输入模式，其稳定性依赖网络架构。

10.1103/23zn-lzx2.note_en: Nonreciprocal coupling stabilizes interacting active systems and associative memory, with effects that differ between persistent and thermal noise.
10.1103/23zn-lzx2.note_zh: 非互易耦合稳定相互作用的活性系统及联想记忆，其效应在持续噪声与热噪声下不同。

10.1103/26rt-yvpn.note_en: Star quantum networks exhibit entanglement thresholds and trade-offs between active branches and sequential nonlocality-sharing depth.
10.1103/26rt-yvpn.note_zh: 星型量子网络存在纠缠阈值，以及活跃分支数与顺序非局域共享深度之间的权衡。

10.1103/33lg-7kmc.note_en: Carleman linearization represents nonlinear graph dynamics as linear dynamics on richer higher-order structures, with exact and truncated constructions.
10.1103/33lg-7kmc.note_zh: Carleman 线性化将非线性图动力学表示为更丰富高阶结构上的线性动力学，提供精确及截断构造。

10.1103/3cmf-cbj3.note_en: An infrastructure-network cascade model separates recoverable failure onset from systemic collapse as efficiency and spatial stress increase.
10.1103/3cmf-cbj3.note_zh: 基础设施网络级联模型区分效率与空间压力增大时的可恢复故障起始和系统性崩溃。

10.1103/3v5l-pgzz.note_en: Electrical and metabolic coupling in an idealized beta-cell ring produces synchronization, traveling waves and traveling chimera states.
10.1103/3v5l-pgzz.note_zh: 理想化胰岛细胞环中的电与代谢耦合产生同步、行波及旅行奇美拉态。

10.1103/3zrx-56mx.note_en: Duplication-divergence graph growth links largest-component transitions to Euler characteristics and scaling of degree-distribution moments.
10.1103/3zrx-56mx.note_zh: 复制—分化图增长将最大连通分量转变与欧拉示性数及度分布矩标度联系起来。

10.1103/48xl-kkq1.note_en: Tuning coherent versus dissipative coupling changes frequency-locking windows and amplitude asymmetry in self-sustained oscillator pairs.
10.1103/48xl-kkq1.note_zh: 调节相干与耗散耦合的比例改变自激振子对的锁频区间及振幅不对称性。

10.1103/4kcg-z9v2.note_en: Equitable partitions yield minimal graph-product representations that preserve relevant spectral and topological properties of quantum-like structures.
10.1103/4kcg-z9v2.note_zh: 等分划分给出量子类比结构的最小图积表示，保留相关谱及拓扑性质。

10.1103/54zg-75zk.note_en: Nonlinear public goods games on hypergraphs relate cooperation and bistability to group sizes, hyperdegree correlations and initial conditions.
10.1103/54zg-75zk.note_zh: 超图非线性公共品博弈将合作及双稳态与群体规模、超度相关和初始条件联系起来。

10.1103/6976-lcw7.note_en: A minimal flocking model attributes wave-like turning-signal propagation to nonreciprocal interactions, supported by spectral and perturbative analyses.
10.1103/6976-lcw7.note_zh: 最小集群模型通过谱及扰动分析，将波状转向信号传播归因于非互易相互作用。

10.1103/6w6f-y2d9.note_en: Fixed-degree Petersen graphs test how connectivity and directedness affect random-field Ising responses and the absence of critical behavior.
10.1103/6w6f-y2d9.note_zh: 固定度 Petersen 图检验连接方式与方向性如何影响随机场 Ising 响应及临界行为缺失。

10.1103/72hc-zmsb.note_en: A solvable random-coupling oscillator model relates frequency dispersion to stationary correlations and suppression of finite-temperature glassy freezing.
10.1103/72hc-zmsb.note_zh: 可解随机耦合振子模型联系频率分散、稳态关联及有限温度玻璃冻结的抑制。

10.1103/73g3-b38r.note_en: Spatial diffusion disorder generates effective healing-rate disorder and changes the contact process's absorbing-state critical behavior.
10.1103/73g3-b38r.note_zh: 空间扩散无序产生有效恢复率无序，改变接触过程的吸收态临界行为。

10.1103/7y6z-4bwy.note_en: Localized phase coupling maps chiral active agents to Josephson-array synchronization and spin-wave transport within a specified dynamical regime.
10.1103/7y6z-4bwy.note_zh: 在特定动力学范围内，局域相位耦合将手性活性粒子联系到 Josephson 阵列同步及自旋波传播。

10.1103/81gf-mlhm.note_en: Community overlap and group size determine conditions for cooperation to spread across community-structured networks.
10.1103/81gf-mlhm.note_zh: 社群重叠与群体规模决定合作跨社群结构网络传播的条件。

10.1103/8p2h-fzt8.note_en: A solvable multispecies model links competing internal and cross-species couplings to a hierarchy of swarmalator ordering transitions.
10.1103/8p2h-fzt8.note_zh: 可解多物种模型将内部与跨物种耦合的竞争联系到群振子有序转变的层次结构。

10.1103/92jk-cj5x.note_en: Correlated Ising spin clusters exhibit dimension-dependent percolation transitions and distinct fractal connectivity in embedded layers.
10.1103/92jk-cj5x.note_zh: 关联 Ising 自旋团簇呈现依赖维度的渗流转变及嵌入层中不同的分形连通性质。

10.1103/996v-4djr.note_en: Synaptic plasticity organizes recurrent spiking networks into hybrid architectures whose collective superbursts encode temporally structured inputs.
10.1103/996v-4djr.note_zh: 突触可塑性将递归脉冲网络组织为混合架构，其集体超爆发编码时间结构化输入。

10.1103/9lmp-pydp.note_en: Local leaf-redirection models explain growing networks' leaf proliferation, sublinear nonleaf counts and algebraic degree-distribution tails.
10.1103/9lmp-pydp.note_zh: 局部叶节点重定向模型解释增长网络中的叶节点增殖、非叶节点亚线性数量及代数度分布尾部。

10.1103/9mgt-48mf.note_en: Generalized network internal energy measures correlation leakage across partitions and connects multiscale community detection to modularity.
10.1103/9mgt-48mf.note_zh: 广义网络内能衡量分区间关联泄漏，将多尺度社区发现与模块度联系起来。

10.1103/9q1j-dlw8.note_en: Graph walkers avoiding one another's planned trajectories develop coexisting periodic and unstructured paths through collective dynamical coupling.
10.1103/9q1j-dlw8.note_zh: 相互避让计划轨迹的图上游走者通过集体动力学耦合形成周期与非结构化路径共存。

10.1103/b7cw-pkzn.note_en: Nonreciprocal interspecies alignment and spontaneous symmetry breaking generate chiral ordering, species separation and coexistence in a multispecies flocking model.
10.1103/b7cw-pkzn.note_zh: 非互易跨物种对齐与自发对称破缺在多物种集群模型中产生手性有序、物种分离及共存。

10.1103/bg2r-m6g5.note_en: LSTM activity exhibits capacity-dependent critical-like avalanches, while heterogeneous branching explains coexistence with long-range temporal correlations.
10.1103/bg2r-m6g5.note_zh: LSTM 活动呈现依赖容量的类临界雪崩，异质分枝机制解释其与长程时间关联的共存。

10.1103/bgx2-wmpr.note_en: A quantum Doob transform adjusts coherent and dissipative generator terms to optimize transport observables in quantum networks.
10.1103/bgx2-wmpr.note_zh: 量子 Doob 变换调节生成元中的相干与耗散项，优化量子网络传播观测量。

10.1103/br97-fw3p.note_en: A two-clique voter model separates fast intergroup alignment from slow consensus diffusion, with asymmetry producing intermediate-coupling optima.
10.1103/br97-fw3p.note_zh: 双团选民模型区分快速群间对齐与缓慢共识扩散，不对称性可产生中等耦合下的最优点。

10.1103/c44l-89p7.note_en: Heat-kernel curvature characterizes structural transitions in reconstructed infection networks and is compared with alternative network-curvature measures.
10.1103/c44l-89p7.note_zh: 热核曲率刻画重建感染网络中的结构转变，并与其他网络曲率指标比较。

10.1103/c742-lgnc.note_en: Self-propulsion reorganizes one-dimensional swarmalators into traveling clusters and split waves, with long chaotic transients in finite systems.
10.1103/c742-lgnc.note_zh: 自推进使一维群振子重组为旅行簇及分裂波，并在有限系统中产生长混沌暂态。

10.1103/c9vq-tclt.note_en: Analytical and simulated epidemic dynamics connect continuous pathogen mutation and selection to spreading conditions across population network structures.
10.1103/c9vq-tclt.note_zh: 解析及模拟疫情动力学将病原体连续变异与选择联系到不同种群网络上的传播条件。

10.1103/d26r-r4gp.note_en: Controlled moment closure provides refinable approximate-master-equation solutions for epidemic spreading, voter dynamics and evolutionary games on networks.
10.1103/d26r-r4gp.note_zh: 受控矩闭合为网络疫情传播、选民动力学及演化博弈提供可逐步改进的近似主方程解。

10.1103/d6lk-4f62.note_en: A multiplex articulation-point definition accounts for cascading removal and characterizes fragmentation vulnerability across empirical and random multilayer networks.
10.1103/d6lk-4f62.note_zh: 多层网络割点定义纳入级联移除，刻画实证及随机多层网络的碎裂脆弱性。

10.1103/fltc-hfvt.note_en: Order-parameter precursors assess solitary desynchronization predictability across forcing and fragility regimes in a coupled Kuramoto chain.
10.1103/fltc-hfvt.note_zh: 序参量前兆评估耦合 Kuramoto 链在不同强迫及脆弱性区间中的孤立失同步可预测性。

10.1103/fsdp-667s.note_en: Inertia and dimensionality parity govern synchronization-transition discontinuity and hysteresis in a generalized multidimensional Kuramoto model.
10.1103/fsdp-667s.note_zh: 惯性及维度奇偶性控制广义多维 Kuramoto 模型中同步转变的不连续性与滞后。

10.1103/ftyk-48y2.note_en: Generator spectra and conductance explain when large Markovian networks develop deterministic or exponential first-passage-time distributions.
10.1103/ftyk-48y2.note_zh: 生成元谱及电导性质解释大型 Markov 网络何时形成确定性或指数首达时间分布。

10.1103/gp7d-fsk5.note_en: Spectral-submanifold reduction predicts aggregate and node-level dynamics near critical transitions in heterogeneous and higher-order nonlinear networks.
10.1103/gp7d-fsk5.note_zh: 谱子流形约化预测异质及高阶非线性网络在临界转变附近的整体和节点动力学。

10.1103/k326-3y4g.note_en: Spatial structure and resource diffusion reshape strategy switching and stability in games with local and global environmental feedback.
10.1103/k326-3y4g.note_zh: 空间结构与资源扩散重塑带局部及全局环境反馈的博弈中的策略切换和稳定性。

10.1103/k9b1-n8mb.note_en: Triadic dispersal interactions produce topology-dependent clustering and synchronization in ecological networks, with stability analyzed through the master stability function.
10.1103/k9b1-n8mb.note_zh: 三体迁移相互作用在生态网络中产生依赖拓扑的聚类与同步，并通过主稳定函数分析稳定性。

10.1103/ktnz-14ft.note_en: Master-stability analysis links nonreciprocal lattice coupling to periodic and quasiperiodic traveling-wave stability and finite-size bounds.
10.1103/ktnz-14ft.note_zh: 主稳定分析将非互易格点耦合与周期及准周期行波的稳定性和有限规模边界联系起来。

10.1103/l51k-63y5.note_en: Parameter-aware reservoirs predict abrupt oscillator-network death transitions and hysteresis, with connectivity inference available when topology is unknown.
10.1103/l51k-63y5.note_zh: 参数感知储备池预测振子网络的突变死亡及滞后，并可在拓扑未知时进行连接推断。

10.1103/m8bw-9fzg.note_en: Information-theoretic analysis compares synaptic learning rules, finding spike-count advantages under low firing rates and sparse plasticity.
10.1103/m8bw-9fzg.note_zh: 信息论分析比较突触学习规则，指出低放电率及稀疏可塑性条件下的脉冲计数优势。

10.1103/m8jf-fjfp.note_en: Linker-mediated colloidal networks separate connectivity percolation, rigidity and gelation through coordination patterns and persistent effective bonds.
10.1103/m8jf-fjfp.note_zh: 连接剂介导胶体网络通过配位模式及有效键持续性区分连通渗流、刚性与凝胶化。

10.1103/n4ps-wmd7.note_en: Fixed-index Hodge spectral tracking detects triangle-deletion vulnerabilities that remain invisible to graph-level connectivity measures.
10.1103/n4ps-wmd7.note_zh: 固定谱索引的 Hodge 跟踪检测三角形删除造成的脆弱性，而图层连通指标可能无法发现。

10.1103/nh3b-1wv5.note_en: Quantum-informed vertex selection augments classical kernelization for maximum independent sets, with an extension to weighted graph problems.
10.1103/nh3b-1wv5.note_zh: 量子信息引导的节点选择扩展最大独立集的经典核化，并可推广到加权图问题。

10.1103/nl7d-16n8.note_en: Closed-form avalanche assembly probabilities connect arbitrary nonnegative coupling matrices to detailed activation patterns in recurrent pulse-coupled networks.
10.1103/nl7d-16n8.note_zh: 雪崩组装概率的闭式表达将任意非负耦合矩阵与递归脉冲耦合网络的详细激活模式联系起来。

10.1103/nvd6-pj1f.note_en: The placement of asymmetric delays reshapes swarmalator collective phases and analytically derived stability boundaries, beyond delay magnitude alone.
10.1103/nvd6-pj1f.note_zh: 非对称时延的作用位置重塑群振子集体相态及解析稳定边界，影响不只来自时延大小。

10.1103/nxwl-5wvf.note_en: Optimal lattice paths develop long-range correlations between selected link times, with direction-dependent statistics associated with first-passage percolation.
10.1103/nxwl-5wvf.note_zh: 最优格点路径中的所选边时间形成长程关联，其方向依赖统计与首达渗流相关。

10.1103/p6qp-2s9f.note_en: Maximum-entropy time-series benchmarks infer signed edges and support assessments of imbalance and community structure in brain networks.
10.1103/p6qp-2s9f.note_zh: 最大熵时间序列基准推断有符号边，支持脑网络不平衡程度及社区结构评估。

10.1103/ppm1-mxhz.note_en: Cross-dimensional random walks rank simplices of different orders and reveal how teleportation affects search on simplicial complexes.
10.1103/ppm1-mxhz.note_zh: 跨维随机游走对不同阶单纯形排序，并揭示瞬移如何影响单纯复形上的搜索。

10.1103/qjl4-wqvx.note_en: A multispecies kinetic theory relates alignment interactions to pattern-forming instabilities, characteristic scales and collective order in active systems.
10.1103/qjl4-wqvx.note_zh: 多物种动理学理论联系对齐相互作用、图样形成失稳、特征尺度及活性系统集体有序。

10.1103/qqwq-7j7j.note_en: Shortest-path stratification reduces multidimensional network dynamics and estimates the single-node control needed to revive a nonideal state.
10.1103/qqwq-7j7j.note_zh: 按最短路径分层约化多维网络动力学，估计从非理想状态恢复所需的单节点控制。

10.1103/rt96-mb8q.note_en: Canonical maximum-entropy null models enable explicit hypothesis tests of community structure rather than only generic network partitioning.
10.1103/rt96-mb8q.note_zh: 正则最大熵零模型对社区结构进行明确假设检验，而非只给出通用网络划分。

10.1103/s6mj-4f1s.note_en: A phase-encoded reliability formulation models interaction and dependency effects in interconnected systems, illustrated with cascading and interdependent network benchmarks.
10.1103/s6mj-4f1s.note_zh: 相位编码可靠性框架描述互联系统的相互作用与依赖效应，并以级联及互依网络基准说明。

10.1103/sbf3-yfl5.note_en: Finite-range two-dimensional k-core percolation shows continuous or discontinuous transitions, with logarithmic finite-size drift in the first-order regime.
10.1103/sbf3-yfl5.note_zh: 有限作用范围的二维 k-core 渗流呈现连续或不连续转变，一阶区间存在对数有限尺寸漂移。

10.1103/t1sg-qhhf.note_en: Local network growth rules increase shortest-path multiplicity and connect its size scaling to degree distributions and community organization.
10.1103/t1sg-qhhf.note_zh: 局部网络增长规则提高最短路径多重性，并将其规模标度与度分布及社区组织联系起来。

10.1103/tmkq-33c4.note_en: Structural-link and synchronized-path exclusion criteria detect remote synchronization in empirical brain networks and oscillator models, with threshold-dependent results.
10.1103/tmkq-33c4.note_zh: 排除结构连接及同步路径的判据检测实证脑网络与振子模型中的远程同步，结果依赖阈值。

10.1103/tpxk-cltw.note_en: Disordered alignment interactions can promote polar flocking through activity-driven clustering and self-organized neighborhoods with cooperative couplings.
10.1103/tpxk-cltw.note_zh: 无序对齐相互作用可经活动驱动聚集及合作耦合邻域的自组织促进极性集群。

10.1103/tt2n-wll8.note_en: Fourier analysis and statistical classification distinguish chimera states in Dirac-coupled topological signals across different network topologies.
10.1103/tt2n-wll8.note_zh: Fourier 分析与统计分类在不同网络拓扑上识别 Dirac 耦合拓扑信号的奇美拉态。

10.1103/txbw-g9cd.note_en: Directed oscillator rings undergo discontinuous frequency ordering and hysteresis, with network size changing the hysteresis width.
10.1103/txbw-g9cd.note_zh: 有向振子环发生不连续频率有序转变及滞后，网络规模改变滞后宽度。

10.1103/v1vq-skr1.note_en: Fast adaptation entrains contrarians into synchronized clusters in adaptive networks, requiring a conformist majority and an intermediate coupling window.
10.1103/v1vq-skr1.note_zh: 快速适应使逆从者在自适应网络中形成同步簇，需要从众者占多数及适中的耦合区间。

10.1103/v3jy-fh5p.note_en: Synaptic coarse-tuning constrains population decoding gains, with strong imprecision producing saturation even in recurrent and feedforward network architectures.
10.1103/v3jy-fh5p.note_zh: 突触粗调限制群体解码收益，强不精确性即使在递归及前馈网络架构中也导致饱和。

10.1103/v5cl-krph.note_en: A unified characteristic equation combines distributed delays, noise and periodic coupling to determine oscillator-ensemble incoherence stability.
10.1103/v5cl-krph.note_zh: 统一特征方程结合分布时延、噪声与周期耦合，确定振子群非相干态稳定性。

10.1103/v5zx-93k9.note_en: Exact pair-coordinate Langevin equations express memory kernels and restoring forces through matrices of arbitrary connected elastic networks.
10.1103/v5zx-93k9.note_zh: 精确双节点坐标 Langevin 方程通过任意连通弹性网络矩阵表达记忆核及恢复力。

10.1103/v94v-3p18.note_en: Nonlinear coherence feedback and finite-population fluctuations reshape Kuramoto synchronization thresholds, bistability and finite-size scaling.
10.1103/v94v-3p18.note_zh: 非线性相干反馈与有限群体涨落重塑 Kuramoto 同步阈值、双稳态及有限尺寸标度。

10.1103/wfn7-h898.note_en: Random rule-based chemical models connect small-world network organization and growth phase diagrams to autocatalysis and multistationarity.
10.1103/wfn7-h898.note_zh: 随机规则化学模型将小世界网络组织及增长相图与自催化和多稳态联系起来。

10.1103/wwyd-bz8n.note_en: Nonlinear mean-field feedback creates additional steady-state branches, two-step synchronization and hysteresis in a three-dimensional Kuramoto model.
10.1103/wwyd-bz8n.note_zh: 非线性平均场反馈在三维 Kuramoto 模型中产生额外稳态分支、两步同步及滞后。

10.1103/wysx-f9l3.note_en: Forced star oscillator networks support separate explosive and drive-entrained remote synchronization states, depending on forcing strength and stimulus location.
10.1103/wysx-f9l3.note_zh: 受迫星型振子网络支持不同的爆炸式及外驱锁定远程同步态，取决于强迫幅度和刺激位置。

10.1103/x15s-84n9.note_en: Dynamical mean-field analysis relates chaos onset in random recurrent networks to kinetic-energy scaling and stationary neural-activity distributions.
10.1103/x15s-84n9.note_zh: 动力学平均场分析将随机递归网络的混沌起始与动能标度及稳态神经活动分布联系起来。

10.1103/xp24-5rj6.note_en: Competing aligning and antialigning copying rules yield mesoscopic polarization dynamics and interaction-dependent fluctuation structure in finite populations.
10.1103/xp24-5rj6.note_zh: 竞争的对齐及反对齐模仿规则产生介观极化动力学及有限群体中依赖相互作用的涨落结构。

10.1103/xsyr-d79f.note_en: Rectangular neighborhood orientation and coordination number alter extended-range bond and site percolation thresholds on square lattices.
10.1103/xsyr-d79f.note_zh: 矩形邻域方向与配位数改变方格上的扩展范围键及位点渗流阈值。

10.1103/xzdr-sh34.note_en: Riemannian multiresolution filtering decomposes time-varying functional connectivity and identifies subnetworks dominating coherent interaction modes across temporal scales.
10.1103/xzdr-sh34.note_zh: Riemann 多分辨率滤波分解时变功能连接，识别在不同时间尺度上主导相干互动模态的子网络。

10.1103/y6ss-j5qv.note_en: Heuristic and exact modularity optimization enforce individual community-size bounds, avoiding indirect size control through a resolution parameter alone.
10.1103/y6ss-j5qv.note_zh: 启发式及精确模块度优化直接约束各社区规模，避免仅通过分辨率参数间接控制。

10.1103/ys6r-4mbf.note_en: Disordered filament polarity and switching transport kinetics create particle localization, strongest at intermediate run lengths in the studied model.
10.1103/ys6r-4mbf.note_zh: 无序丝状结构极性与切换传播动力学产生粒子局域化，在所研究模型中以中等行程长度最强。

10.1103/yz2d-wk6g.note_en: Nonreciprocal flocking exhibits restricted, long-lived chiral transients whose stability depends on density, motility, coupling and finite system size.
10.1103/yz2d-wk6g.note_zh: 非互易集群呈现受限而长寿命的手性暂态，其稳定性依赖密度、运动性、耦合及有限系统规模。

10.1103/znwb-71hy.note_en: Geometric disorder creates hierarchical spin-network couplings that separate local cluster equilibration from much slower global transport relaxation.
10.1103/znwb-71hy.note_zh: 几何无序产生层次自旋网络耦合，使局部团簇平衡与更缓慢的整体传播弛豫分离。

10.1103/43yn-sh6g.note_en: Higher-order orientation statistics alter stick-network percolation thresholds even when the mean orientational order is unchanged.
10.1103/43yn-sh6g.note_zh: 平均取向序参量相同的二维棒接触网络，高阶取向统计仍会改变几何渗流阈值。

10.1063/5.0344726.note_en: Recurrence-based functional networks and graph diffusion distinguish seizure states and reveal state-dependent differences in brain-network organization.
10.1063/5.0344726.note_zh: 结合联合复现功能网络和图扩散识别癫痫状态，并分析不同状态下脑网络组织的差异。

10.1063/5.0354201.note_en: In coevolving strategy and interaction networks, stronger rationality can rescue cooperation that weak selection cannot sustain.
10.1063/5.0354201.note_zh: 在策略与连接共同演化的网络上，增强理性可以恢复弱选择条件下无法维持的合作。

10.1073/pnas.2611888123.note_en: Generalized fluctuation scaling extends Taylor’s law to dependent, heterogeneous heavy-tailed data with infinite moments, including applications to network data.
10.1073/pnas.2611888123.note_zh: 将 Taylor 定律推广到具有依赖性和异质性的无限矩重尾数据，并展示网络数据应用。

10.1063/5.0355932.note_en: Bargaining preferences shape cost sharing and cooperation in snowdrift games, with effects that depend on heterogeneity and network connectivity.
10.1063/5.0355932.note_zh: 在雪堆博弈中，谈判偏好改变成本分担与合作水平；偏好异质性和网络连接度均有影响。

10.1073/pnas.2617622123.note_en: Hillfort visibility and walking-cost networks link terrain to defensive community size and cohesion in the pre-Hispanic Andes.
10.1073/pnas.2617622123.note_zh: 用山堡间可视性与步行成本构建防御网络，分析安第斯地形与社区规模、凝聚性的关系。

10.1038/s42005-026-02894-z.note_en: Face-contact probabilities control granular cluster size, while connected-cluster random-walk statistics remain universal across particle shapes and packing fractions.
10.1038/s42005-026-02894-z.note_zh: 面接触概率控制颗粒连接簇的大小，而簇的随机游走统计在不同颗粒形状和堆积分数下保持普适性。

10.1103/fqfg-ml34.note_en: Graphon operator spectra determine Ising critical temperatures across network topologies, providing tractable models of phase transitions and multistability.
10.1103/fqfg-ml34.note_zh: Graphon 算子谱决定不同网络拓扑上的 Ising 临界温度，为相变和多稳态提供可解析模型。

10.1103/k5hq-js7c.note_en: A tunable hyperedge failure threshold unifies limiting resilience models and determines how cumulative node failures change hypernetwork percolation.
10.1103/k5hq-js7c.note_zh: 以可调超边失效阈值统一高阶网络韧性模型，分析累积节点失效如何改变渗流和稳定性。

10.1103/t3zw-cs6c.note_en: Strategy and payoff-parameter coevolution on a square lattice produces cooperative or defective states, with rare mutations benefiting cooperation.
10.1103/t3zw-cs6c.note_zh: 方格交互网络上的策略与收益参数共同演化产生合作或背叛状态；稀少突变有利于合作态收益增长。

10.1103/y353-z8sb.note_en: Phase lags in higher-order oscillator communities generate oscillatory or chaotic synchronization and multistability, captured by a reduced macroscopic model.
10.1103/y353-z8sb.note_zh: 高阶耦合振子社区中的相位迟滞可诱发振荡、混沌同步与多稳态，并可用低维宏观模型描述。

10.1103/c8kc-rklj.note_en: A nonequilibrium flow-design framework incorporates Markov-network topology and cost–benefit trade-offs to optimize molecular motors, proofreading and enzyme inhibition.
10.1103/c8kc-rklj.note_zh: 将 Markov 网络拓扑和成本收益权衡纳入非平衡流设计，用于分子马达、校对机制和酶抑制优化。

10.1103/32qy-2v16.note_en: Twisted graph-cycle matrices describe steady-state current fluctuations under finite affinity and reveal a noise transition in a Brownian computation model.
10.1103/32qy-2v16.note_zh: 通过扭曲图环矩阵刻画有限热力学力下的稳态电流涨落，并揭示布朗计算模型中的噪声转变。

10.1103/47l4-6jn5.note_en: Graphicality phase diagrams identify when power-law and double-power-law degree sequences can form simple graphs, including distinct failure mechanisms.
10.1103/47l4-6jn5.note_zh: 给出幂律和双幂律度序列的可图性相图，辨析其无法形成简单图的不同机制。

10.1103/6jqp-bz2r.note_en: Temporal clique graphs permit a piecewise mean-field SIS solution and prevalence approximations tested on random-walker-induced contact networks.
10.1103/6jqp-bz2r.note_zh: 对时变团接触网络推导分段平均场 SIS 解，并在随机游走诱导网络上检验感染率近似。

10.1103/cbwg-5nw6.note_en: An information-transmission model estimates how single-gene knock-ins could restore information in aged regulatory networks, using mouse muscle expression data.
10.1103/cbwg-5nw6.note_zh: 利用小鼠肌肉表达数据和信息传输模型，估计单基因外源表达如何恢复老化调控网络中的信息。

10.1103/kwr4-pzn2.note_en: Environmental responses and competition can cancel in equal-time abundance correlations, limiting ecological interaction inference without additional mechanistic information.
10.1103/kwr4-pzn2.note_zh: 环境响应与竞争效应可在等时丰度相关中相互抵消，提示生态相互作用推断需要额外的机制信息。

10.1103/m57p-97jv.note_en: Signed Laplacian modes reconstruct frozen Ising configurations and provide a low-dimensional search for low-energy spin-glass states.
10.1103/m57p-97jv.note_zh: 用图拉普拉斯模态的符号构型重建冻结 Ising 状态，并在低维模态空间搜索自旋玻璃低能态。

10.1103/nl4b-7sfq.note_en: Analytical mean-field solutions characterize noisy quadratic integrate-and-fire populations and the interplay of electrical and chemical coupling in neuronal networks.
10.1103/nl4b-7sfq.note_zh: 推导含噪二次积分发放神经元群体的平均场解析解，分析神经网络中电与化学突触耦合的共同作用。

10.1103/zrk4-g7fj.note_en: Nonlinear behavioral feedback and social influence produce abrupt intervention abandonment and epidemic oscillations, with robustness tested in networked populations.
10.1103/zrk4-g7fj.note_zh: 非线性行为反馈和社会影响可导致干预行为突降与疫情周期波动，并在网络化群体中检验其稳健性。

10.1103/qftv-sbqs.note_en: Spectral formulas give first-encounter times for simultaneously resetting network walkers and identify when resetting improves collective search.
10.1103/qftv-sbqs.note_zh: 推导同步重置网络随机行者的首遇时间谱公式，并给出重置能够改善集体搜索的判据。

10.1103/qnhv-yp69.note_en: Monte Carlo simulations map geometric scaling and logarithmic corrections in long-range loop-erased random walks across spatial dimensions.
10.1103/qnhv-yp69.note_zh: 通过 Monte Carlo 模拟分析长程消圈随机游走在不同空间维度中的几何标度、对数修正与长短程交叉。

10.1103/25qf-sfsw.note_en: Graph-based replicator dynamics yield defection-spreading timescales, connecting cooperation collapse to node degree, degree heterogeneity and network spectra.
10.1103/25qf-sfsw.note_zh: 基于图上的复制动力学刻画背叛传播时间，将合作崩溃与节点度、度异质性及网络谱联系起来。

10.1103/3cct-tlk7.note_en: Connection delays govern single-step or multistep synchronization transitions in adaptive networks, with analytical conditions for two-cluster states.
10.1103/3cct-tlk7.note_zh: 连接时延控制自适应网络中的单步或多步同步相变，并可推导双簇状态存在的解析条件。

10.1073/pnas.2620995123.note_en: A rat nervous-system model relates hierarchical modules and rich-club integration to the spread of local connectivity perturbations.
10.1073/pnas.2620995123.note_zh: 大鼠神经系统的加权有向模型连接层级模块、富俱乐部整合与局部连接扰动的传播。

10.1103/mnvf-tq6g.note_en: A Bayesian analysis tracks weakening lagged-correlation connectivity among climate tipping elements under stronger forcing; the inferred links do not establish causation.
10.1103/mnvf-tq6g.note_zh: 贝叶斯分析刻画较强外部强迫下气候临界要素的滞后相关连接减弱；相关边不代表因果作用。

10.1103/m6s5-r1cq.note_en: Local two-queue gate control smooths jamming transitions under periodic inflow, with proposed applications to transport networks and packet routing.
10.1103/m6s5-r1cq.note_zh: 周期性流入下，局域双队列门控使拥堵跃迁趋于连续；作者提出向交通网络和数据包路由迁移。

10.1073/pnas.2601203123.note_en: Human and rat functional networks show shared hippocampal hub organization during approach–avoidance conflict, alongside topology differences associated with behavior and sex.
10.1073/pnas.2601203123.note_zh: 人鼠趋避冲突任务的功能网络呈现共同的海马枢纽组织，并报告与行为及性别相关的拓扑差异。

10.1038/s41467-026-77850-0.note_en: During bacterial adaptation, a metabolite shifts from the periphery to a connector between correlation-network clusters, revealing system-level metabolic reorganization.
10.1038/s41467-026-77850-0.note_zh: 细菌适应过程中，代谢物从相关网络外围转为簇间连接者，揭示系统层面的代谢网络重组。

10.1103/vxkg-41kp.note_en: Editor-selected reading: a multilayer rumor model examines media interventions and social reinforcement; its abstract does not specify contact topology or establish intervention causality.
10.1103/vxkg-41kp.note_zh: 编辑选定相关阅读：多层谣言模型分析媒体干预与社会强化；摘要未明确接触拓扑，也未证明干预因果效果。

10.1063/5.0340752.note_en: Obstacles and coupling shape spiral-wave propagation and interlayer synchronization in bilayer memristive neuronal media.
10.1063/5.0340752.note_zh: 障碍与耦合如何改变双层忆阻神经元系统中的螺旋波传播和层间同步？

10.1063/5.0355263.note_en: Climate networks reveal opposite seasonal changes in Arctic circulation and temperature connectivity within a common quantitative framework.
10.1063/5.0355263.note_zh: 气候网络揭示北极环流与温度连通组织在冬夏之间呈相反变化。

10.1073/pnas.2538056123.note_en: Recurrent regulatory motifs combine into hypermotif circuits whose wiring links developmental architecture to emergent dynamics.
10.1073/pnas.2538056123.note_zh: 发育调控网络中的重复模体组合为超模体，将调控架构与涌现动力学联系起来。

10.1073/pnas.2538060123.note_en: Intercellular hypermotif topologies connect regulatory loops and generate oscillatory or antagonistic morphogen responses in dynamical models.
10.1073/pnas.2538060123.note_zh: 跨细胞超模体连接调控回路，其拓扑可在动力学模型中产生振荡或拮抗的形态发生信号响应。

10.1103/p2cj-1kkl.note_en: Finite-memory gate sequences control operator transport, scrambling and persistent correlations across qubit networks, using graph cover time.
10.1103/p2cj-1kkl.note_zh: 有限记忆门序列借助图覆盖时间分析，调控量子比特网络上的算符输运、混洗及持续相关。

10.1103/pngx-s5xx.note_en: Information-theoretic signatures distinguish higher-order contagion mechanisms from cross-order behaviors; synergy best identifies mechanism order among tested measures.
10.1103/pngx-s5xx.note_zh: 信息论指标区分高阶传播机制与跨阶行为；在所比较指标中，协同信息最可靠地识别机制所在阶数。
